name: Joseph Loe
headline: Team Leader, Software Engineer, Technical Artist & Virtual Production Supervisor
contactSubtitle: I'm always open to discussing new projects, opportunities, or just having a chat about technology and creativity.
bio: Joseph Loe is a Head of Technology and software engineer with over two decades spanning full-stack development, virtual production, live events, and game development. He blends deep engineering experience with technical artistry and team leadership, specialising in real-time graphics systems and translating cutting-edge R&D into robust, production-ready pipelines. A fast adopter of agentic AI and generative tooling, he folds the best of each new model into practical workflows — from accelerating development to producing previs and concept art. Above all, he's motivated by automation, procedural generation, and pushing the boundaries of what real-time technology can do.

experience.title: Head of Technology, Full-time

With over two decades of experience spanning software engineering, technical artistry, and leadership roles, I bring a proven record of accomplishment of delivering innovative solutions and driving cutting-edge R&D initiatives in virtual production environments.

A hands-on leader, I have overseen over 25+ VP shoots and played a pivotal role in minimizing stage downtime and advancing virtual production techniques.

experience.title: Senior Technical Artist, Full-time
experience.description: I was promoted to a Senior technical position as I drove innovation and functionality to the ARRI – CT Virtual Production stage, expanding my knowledge of film/virtual production techniques and debugging/optimising Unreal engine projects. Worked on over 25+ VP shoots, and lead R&D efforts in reducing stage downtime, LED colour workflows, DMX integrations, Network upgrades, Remote operation/control, Tracking systems, and other projects to demo.

experience.title: Software Engineer, Full-time
experience.description: Live events company, dealing with big names from sports to film to corporate. Fast paced work environment with very strict and unyielding deadlines, the show must go on. Started as one of two full-stack developers, key responsibilities include Requirement analysis from clients, design and implementation of both hardware and software architectures. Most projects involve AWS with Lambda/EC2/S3/CloudFront/SES/SNS integrations using SQL/NOSQL databases with a HTML/JS frontend which I used to solely maintain, mostly for legacy reasons. However, decided to transition to using Azure and Microsoft services, .Net and Blazor framework to create a multi-platform fully integrated streaming service to accommodate the shifting climate in live events.

experience.title: Software Engineer

interests.title: Gaming
interests.description: I’ve always enjoyed gaming, and within most multiplayer games such as Runescape, Minecraft, LOL, Halo and Destiny/2 I’ve strived to create communities or clans as I believe this adds to the experience.

interests.title: AI and Procedural generation
interests.description: AI has always interested me, automation and procedural generation influence all my projects. Throughout my studies I have always excelled in AI modules and for my final year project at university I experimented and studied with Genetic Algorithms and meta-heuristic search problems.

interests.title: Sports
interests.description: I also enjoy Muay Thai and MMA in my free time to keep fit and release stress, as I find it very calming and beneficial to keep both an active mind and body. As well as loving to play a game of golf or snooker whenever I get the chance.

interests.title: AI / Generative Art
interests.description: Deeply invested in the fast-moving generative AI space, both as a creative medium and a development accelerator. On the coding side I work daily with agentic and assistant tools — Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini and the wider OpenAI ecosystem — to prototype, refactor and ship faster. For generative imagery and video I combine Stable Diffusion with upscalers, alongside newer models such as SeedDance and Leonardo, to produce previs, concept textures and motion studies for game jams and virtual production. I enjoy staying on the bleeding edge, comparing model strengths, and folding the best of each into practical pipelines.

interests.title: Gaussian Splats
interests.description: Exploring 3D Gaussian Splatting (Gaussian Splats) for fast scene capture and real-time rendering—especially where it overlaps with NeRFs and virtual production workflows.
